entries.title: Psalms 119:1
segments: ¶ALEPH. Blessed [are] the undefiled in the way, Who walk in the law of the LORD!

entries.title: Psalms 119:2
segments: Blessed [are] those who keep His testimonies, Who seek Him with the whole heart!

entries.title: Psalms 119:3
segments: They also do no iniquity; They walk in His ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:4
segments: ¶You have commanded [us] To keep Your precepts diligently.

entries.title: Psalms 119:5
segments: Oh, that my ways were directed To keep Your statutes!

entries.title: Psalms 119:6
segments: Then I would not be ashamed, When I look into all Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:7
segments: ¶I will praise You with uprightness of heart, When I learn Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:8
segments: I will keep Your statutes; Oh, do not forsake me utterly!

entries.title: Psalms 119:9
segments: ¶BETH. How can a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:10
segments: ¶With my whole heart I have sought You; Oh, let me not wander from Your commandments!

entries.title: Psalms 119:11
segments: ¶Your word I have hidden in my heart, That I might not sin against You!

entries.title: Psalms 119:12
segments: ¶Blessed [are] You, O LORD! Teach me Your statutes!

entries.title: Psalms 119:13
segments: ¶With my lips I have declared All the judgments of Your mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:14
segments: I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, As [much as] in all riches.

entries.title: Psalms 119:15
segments: I will meditate on Your precepts, And contemplate Your ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:16
segments: I will delight myself in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:17
segments: ¶GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Your servant, [That] I may live and keep Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:18
segments: ¶Open my eyes, that I may see Wondrous things from Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:19
segments: ¶I [am] a stranger in the earth; Do not hide Your commandments from me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:20
segments: ¶My soul breaks with longing For Your judgments at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 119:21
segments: ¶You rebuke the proud-the cursed, Who stray from Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:22
segments: ¶Remove from me reproach and contempt, For I have kept Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:23
segments: ¶Princes also sit [and] speak against me, [But] Your servant meditates on Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:24
segments: ¶Your testimonies also [are] my delight [And] my counselors.

entries.title: Psalms 119:25
segments: ¶DALETH. My soul clings to the dust; Revive me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:26
segments: ¶I have declared my ways, and You answered me; Teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:27
segments: Make me understand the way of Your precepts; So shall I meditate on Your wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 119:28
segments: ¶My soul melts from heaviness; Strengthen me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:29
segments: Remove from me the way of lying, And grant me Your law graciously.

entries.title: Psalms 119:30
segments: ¶I have chosen the way of truth; Your judgments I have laid [before me].

entries.title: Psalms 119:31
segments: I cling to Your testimonies; O LORD, do not put me to shame!

entries.title: Psalms 119:32
segments: I will run the course of Your commandments, For You shall enlarge my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:33
segments: ¶HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, And I shall keep it [to] the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:34
segments: Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; Indeed, I shall observe it with [my] whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:35
segments: ¶Make me walk in the path of Your commandments, For I delight in it.

entries.title: Psalms 119:36
segments: Incline my heart to Your testimonies, And not to covetousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:37
segments: ¶Turn away my eyes from looking at worthless things, [And] revive me in Your way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:38
segments: ¶Establish Your word to Your servant, Who [is devoted] to fearing You.

entries.title: Psalms 119:39
segments: ¶Turn away my reproach which I dread, For Your judgments [are] good.

entries.title: Psalms 119:40
segments: ¶Behold, I long for Your precepts; Revive me in Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:41
segments: ¶WAW. Let Your mercies come also to me, O LORD-Your salvation according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:42
segments: So shall I have an answer for him who reproaches me, For I trust in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:43
segments: ¶And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, For I have hoped in Your ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:44
segments: So shall I keep Your law continually, Forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:45
segments: ¶And I will walk at liberty, For I seek Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:46
segments: I will speak of Your testimonies also before kings, And will not be ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:47
segments: And I will delight myself in Your commandments, Which I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:48
segments: My hands also I will lift up to Your commandments, Which I love, And I will meditate on Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:49
segments: ¶ZAYIN. Remember the word to Your servant, Upon which You have caused me to hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:50
segments: ¶This [is] my comfort in my affliction, For Your word has given me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:51
segments: ¶The proud have me in great derision, [Yet] I do not turn aside from Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:52
segments: ¶I remembered Your judgments of old, O LORD, And have comforted myself.

entries.title: Psalms 119:53
segments: ¶Indignation has taken hold of me Because of the wicked, who forsake Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:54
segments: ¶Your statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.

entries.title: Psalms 119:55
segments: ¶I remember Your name in the night, O LORD, And I keep Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:56
segments: This has become mine, Because I kept Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:57
segments: ¶HETH. [You are] my portion, O LORD; I have said that I would keep Your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:58
segments: ¶I entreated Your favor with [my] whole heart; Be merciful to me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:59
segments: ¶I thought about my ways, And turned my feet to Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:60
segments: I made haste, and did not delay To keep Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:61
segments: ¶The cords of the wicked have bound me, [But] I have not forgotten Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:62
segments: ¶At midnight I will rise to give thanks to You, Because of Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:63
segments: ¶I [am] a companion of all who fear You, And of those who keep Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:64
segments: ¶The earth, O LORD, is full of Your mercy; Teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:65
segments: ¶TETH. You have dealt well with Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:66
segments: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, For I believe Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:67
segments: ¶Before I was afflicted I went astray, But now I keep Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:68
segments: ¶You [are] good, and do good; Teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:69
segments: ¶The proud have forged a lie against me, [But] I will keep Your precepts with [my] whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:70
segments: Their heart is as fat as grease, [But] I delight in Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:71
segments: ¶[It is] good for me that I have been afflicted, That I may learn Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:72
segments: ¶The law of Your mouth [is] better to me Than thousands of [coins of] gold and silver.

entries.title: Psalms 119:73
segments: ¶YOD. Your hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:74
segments: ¶Those who fear You will be glad when they see me, Because I have hoped in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:75
segments: ¶I know, O LORD, that Your judgments [are] right, And [that] in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:76
segments: ¶Let, I pray, Your merciful kindness be for my comfort, According to Your word to Your servant.

entries.title: Psalms 119:77
segments: Let Your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; For Your law [is] my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:78
segments: ¶Let the proud be ashamed, For they treated me wrongfully with falsehood; [But] I will meditate on Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:79
segments: Let those who fear You turn to me, Those who know Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:80
segments: ¶Let my heart be blameless regarding Your statutes, That I may not be ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:81
segments: ¶KAPH. My soul faints for Your salvation, But I hope in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:82
segments: My eyes fail [from searching] Your word, Saying, "When will You comfort me?"

entries.title: Psalms 119:83
segments: ¶For I have become like a wineskin in smoke, [Yet] I do not forget Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:84
segments: ¶How many [are] the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment on those who persecute me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:85
segments: ¶The proud have dug pits for me, Which [is] not according to Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:86
segments: All Your commandments [are] faithful; They persecute me wrongfully; Help me!

entries.title: Psalms 119:87
segments: They almost made an end of me on earth, But I did not forsake Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:88
segments: ¶Revive me according to Your lovingkindness, So that I may keep the testimony of Your mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:89
segments: ¶LAMED. Forever, O LORD, Your word is settled in heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 119:90
segments: Your faithfulness [endures] to all generations; You established the earth, and it abides.

entries.title: Psalms 119:91
segments: They continue this day according to Your ordinances, For all [are] Your servants.

entries.title: Psalms 119:92
segments: ¶Unless Your law [had been] my delight, I would then have perished in my affliction.

entries.title: Psalms 119:93
segments: ¶I will never forget Your precepts, For by them You have given me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:94
segments: ¶I [am] Yours, save me; For I have sought Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:95
segments: ¶The wicked wait for me to destroy me, [But] I will consider Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:96
segments: ¶I have seen the consummation of all perfection, [But] Your commandment [is] exceedingly broad.

entries.title: Psalms 119:97
segments: ¶MEM. Oh, how I love Your law! It [is] my meditation all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 119:98
segments: ¶You, through Your commandments, make me wiser than my enemies; For they [are] ever with me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:99
segments: I have more understanding than all my teachers, For Your testimonies [are] my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 119:100
segments: I understand more than the ancients, Because I keep Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:101
segments: ¶I have restrained my feet from every evil way, That I may keep Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:102
segments: ¶I have not departed from Your judgments, For You Yourself have taught me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:103
segments: ¶How sweet are Your words to my taste, [Sweeter] than honey to my mouth!

entries.title: Psalms 119:104
segments: Through Your precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:105
segments: ¶NUN. Your word [is] a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.

entries.title: Psalms 119:106
segments: ¶I have sworn and confirmed That I will keep Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:107
segments: ¶I am afflicted very much; Revive me, O LORD, according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:108
segments: ¶Accept, I pray, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:109
segments: ¶My life [is] continually in my hand, Yet I do not forget Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:110
segments: The wicked have laid a snare for me, Yet I have not strayed from Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:111
segments: ¶Your testimonies I have taken as a heritage forever, For they [are] the rejoicing of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:112
segments: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes Forever, to the very end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:113
segments: ¶SAMEK. I hate the double-minded, But I love Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:114
segments: ¶You [are] my hiding place and my shield; I hope in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:115
segments: ¶Depart from me, you evildoers, For I will keep the commandments of my God!

entries.title: Psalms 119:116
segments: ¶Uphold me according to Your word, that I may live; And do not let me be ashamed of my hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:117
segments: Hold me up, and I shall be safe, And I shall observe Your statutes continually.

entries.title: Psalms 119:118
segments: ¶You reject all those who stray from Your statutes, For their deceit [is] falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 119:119
segments: You put away all the wicked of the earth [like] dross; Therefore I love Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:120
segments: My flesh trembles for fear of You, And I am afraid of Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:121
segments: ¶AYIN. I have done justice and righteousness; Do not leave me to my oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 119:122
segments: Be surety for Your servant for good; Do not let the proud oppress me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:123
segments: ¶My eyes fail [from seeking] Your salvation And Your righteous word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:124
segments: ¶Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, And teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:125
segments: I [am] Your servant; Give me understanding, That I may know Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:126
segments: ¶[It is] time for [You] to act, O LORD, [For] they have regarded Your law as void.

entries.title: Psalms 119:127
segments: ¶Therefore I love Your commandments More than gold, yes, than fine gold!

entries.title: Psalms 119:128
segments: Therefore all [Your] precepts [concerning] all [things] I consider [to be] right; I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:129
segments: ¶PE. Your testimonies are wonderful; Therefore my soul keeps them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:130
segments: ¶The entrance of Your words gives light; It gives understanding to the simple.

entries.title: Psalms 119:131
segments: ¶I opened my mouth and panted, For I longed for Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:132
segments: ¶Look upon me and be merciful to me, As Your custom [is] toward those who love Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 119:133
segments: ¶Direct my steps by Your word, And let no iniquity have dominion over me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:134
segments: ¶Redeem me from the oppression of man, That I may keep Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:135
segments: ¶Make Your face shine upon Your servant, And teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:136
segments: ¶Rivers of water run down from my eyes, Because [men] do not keep Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:137
segments: ¶TSADDE. Righteous [are] You, O LORD, And upright [are] Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:138
segments: Your testimonies, [which] You have commanded, [Are] righteous and very faithful.

entries.title: Psalms 119:139
segments: ¶My zeal has consumed me, Because my enemies have forgotten Your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:140
segments: ¶Your word [is] very pure; Therefore Your servant loves it.

entries.title: Psalms 119:141
segments: ¶I [am] small and despised, [Yet] I do not forget Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:142
segments: ¶Your righteousness [is] an everlasting righteousness, And Your law [is] truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:143
segments: ¶Trouble and anguish have overtaken me, [Yet] Your commandments [are] my delights.

entries.title: Psalms 119:144
segments: The righteousness of Your testimonies [is] everlasting; Give me understanding, and I shall live.

entries.title: Psalms 119:145
segments: ¶QOPH. I cry out with [my] whole heart; Hear me, O LORD! I will keep Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:146
segments: I cry out to You; Save me, and I will keep Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:147
segments: ¶I rise before the dawning of the morning, And cry for help; I hope in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:148
segments: My eyes are awake through the [night] watches, That I may meditate on Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:149
segments: ¶Hear my voice according to Your lovingkindness; O LORD, revive me according to Your justice.

entries.title: Psalms 119:150
segments: ¶They draw near who follow after wickedness; They are far from Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:151
segments: You [are] near, O LORD, And all Your commandments [are] truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:152
segments: ¶Concerning Your testimonies, I have known of old that You have founded them forever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:153
segments: ¶RESH. Consider my affliction and deliver me, For I do not forget Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:154
segments: Plead my cause and redeem me; Revive me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:155
segments: ¶Salvation [is] far from the wicked, For they do not seek Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:156
segments: ¶Great [are] Your tender mercies, O LORD; Revive me according to Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:157
segments: ¶Many [are] my persecutors and my enemies, [Yet] I do not turn from Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:158
segments: ¶I see the treacherous, and am disgusted, Because they do not keep Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:159
segments: ¶Consider how I love Your precepts; Revive me, O LORD, according to Your lovingkindness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:160
segments: ¶The entirety of Your word [is] truth, And every one of Your righteous judgments [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:161
segments: ¶SHIN. Princes persecute me without a cause, But my heart stands in awe of Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:162
segments: ¶I rejoice at Your word As one who finds great treasure.

entries.title: Psalms 119:163
segments: ¶I hate and abhor lying, [But] I love Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:164
segments: ¶Seven times a day I praise You, Because of Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:165
segments: ¶Great peace have those who love Your law, And nothing causes them to stumble.

entries.title: Psalms 119:166
segments: ¶LORD, I hope for Your salvation, And I do Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:167
segments: ¶My soul keeps Your testimonies, And I love them exceedingly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:168
segments: I keep Your precepts and Your testimonies, For all my ways [are] before You.

entries.title: Psalms 119:169
segments: ¶TAU. Let my cry come before You, O LORD; Give me understanding according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:170
segments: Let my supplication come before You; Deliver me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:171
segments: ¶My lips shall utter praise, For You teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:172
segments: ¶My tongue shall speak of Your word, For all Your commandments [are] righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:173
segments: ¶Let Your hand become my help, For I have chosen Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:174
segments: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, And Your law [is] my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:175
segments: ¶Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; And let Your judgments help me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:176
segments: ¶I have gone astray like a lost sheep; Seek Your servant, For I do not forget Your commandments.
